video_title: SHOCKING Risers & Fallers In NBA Future Power Rankings

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Hoop Collective announces a 2026 world tour
quotes.excerpt: We're going to take the Hoop Collective on a world tour coming up here in the first week of October.
quotes.quote: Against my better judgment and assuring that Jackson is going to be driven to an asylum, Bobby, MacMahon, Jackson and I are going on a little trip here. We're going to take the Hoop Collective on a world tour coming up here in the first week of October. We're going to go to Melbourne, Australia and have a podcast live event on Friday, October 2nd at CourtSide Melbourne, which is an awesome venue. Then the three of us are going to go on Monday, October 5th and have an event in Manila, Philippines. We know we have so many Filipino fans who are supporters of the podcast and have listened for years. I had a great experience there three years ago and I said I've got to try to come back and do a podcast event, so that's what we're going to do.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Oklahoma City Thunder top the NBA Future Power Rankings
quotes.excerpt: Oklahoma City Thunder, who I believe were number one last year as well.
quotes.quote: Number one, Oklahoma City Thunder, who I believe were number one last year as well. They ranked number one in players, number one in management, and number four in draft because they've got all those draft picks from other teams coming up. They have shed some players this off-season so that they can create room to pay guys like Cason Wallace and keep Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Chet Holmgren, and Jalen Williams together along with Alex Caruso, and they did re-sign Isaiah Hartenstein.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Questioning Boston's third-place ranking after the Jaylen Brown trade
quotes.excerpt: They have the Boston Celtics as third fresh off of a widely panned trade where they gave up an all-NBA player.
quotes.quote: They have the Boston Celtics as third fresh off of a widely panned trade where they gave up an all-NBA player in his prime in Jaylen Brown. Management is number two, which listen, Brad Stevens is, you hear Brad Stevens, Sam Presti, those are the consensus, those are the top two lead basketball executives in the NBA, despite the fact that again, Brad Stevens got ripped by a lot of people for the Jaylen Brown trade that they executed.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics' high valuation of Mitchell Robinson
quotes.excerpt: The Celtics really think Mitchell Robinson is a valuable player.
quotes.quote: I was just talking with an executive the other day. Mitchell Robinson, this is going to be a very interesting season because the Celtics really think Mitchell Robinson is a valuable player and really prioritized getting him in the off-season and prioritized getting him off the court when they played in the playoffs two years ago. They obviously love what the analytics say about Mitchell Robinson and they didn't love what the analytics said about Jaylen Brown.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul George's contract as a placeholder for future flexibility
quotes.excerpt: Paul George in terms of their roster build is a placeholder.
quotes.quote: You traded Jaylen Brown for a placeholder and picks. Paul George in terms of their roster build is a placeholder. You're not trading him this year because it's still a god-awful contract. It's one of the worst contracts in the league until next summer when it is a 50-whatever million dollar expiring deal and then you can use it as a chip in trade talks just to make money work.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson's contract extension and future status
quotes.excerpt: Mitchell Robinson is eligible for a contract extension starting in two weeks.
quotes.quote: Mitchell Robinson is eligible for a contract extension starting in two weeks. That's the most he can sign for, three and 67. He has two years at $8 million a year left, which is awesome value. If the Knicks stick to the Jim Dolan edict of no second apron and they've gone up to the line three years in a row and not crossed it, if they stick to that and they sign Mitchell Robinson to an extension that's in the neighborhood of that $60 million a year, they're not going to be able to keep this team together.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The danger of Detroit signing Jaylen Duren to a qualifying offer
quotes.excerpt: The Pistons cannot allow him to sign for the qualifying offer.
quotes.quote: The Pistons cannot allow him to sign for the qualifying offer. If he signs for the qualifying offer, he's gone. He's gone. And not only that, you now are going to have a player who's playing on the qualifying offer and is going to make decisions based on that. And he and his agents know that.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlotte Hornets' strategy of trading valuable players for assets
quotes.excerpt: They took two players that had increased their value in LaMelo and Miles Bridges and they sold them.
quotes.quote: My biggest admiration for what they did this year is they did not believe the team that they had was a team that they thought could win at a high level. And so they took two players that had increased their value in LaMelo and Miles Bridges and they sold them. Our analysts believe they sold them well because they've ranked their draft two in money three, even though there's a very good chance Brandon Miller is going to get an extension. I think that they are committed to getting that deal done.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: They are about to give Kawhi Leonard a contract extension that is reportedly worth more than $120 million.
quotes.quote: They are about to give Kawhi Leonard a contract extension that is reportedly worth more than $120 million. I think Jake Fischer reported that. He just said that's the that's the max. I don't expect them to get I don't expect him to get less.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' flexibility if Steph Curry doesn't extend
quotes.excerpt: If Steph doesn't extend, which he's now almost a month past his extension, they're going to have a lot of flexibility.
quotes.quote: If Steph doesn't extend, which he's now almost a month past his extension, they're going to have a lot of flexibility. That doesn't mean that they're going to be able to get star players, but they're going to have a lot of flexibility.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' draft success and aggressive win-now moves
quotes.excerpt: The team that finished last in the draft, the Minnesota Timberwolves, is to me a pretty interesting thing.
quotes.quote: The team that finished last in the draft, the Minnesota Timberwolves, is to me a pretty interesting thing. There's not a whole lot of teams who have won at least a playoff series, if not multiple playoff series, in each of the last three seasons. The Timberwolves are one of them. And just made a win-now move this summer. So that's a pretty interesting ranking there.
